text_markup: The base trace strength of a trace attempt is a value. See {ref:sec_traces} for rules about trace attempts. A base trace strength value does not need to be greater than 0 for the trace attempt to occur.
text_plain: The base trace strength of a trace attempt is a value. See section 10.8 for rules about trace attempts. A base trace strength value does not need to be greater than 0 for the trace attempt to occur.
